claim: The user guide says RDS Blue/Green Deployments support Amazon RDS Proxy and smart drivers, which reduce writer node upgrade downtime during switchover by redirecting connections to the new production environment without waiting for DNS propagation.

evidence.quote: Amazon RDS Blue/Green Deployments support Amazon RDS Proxy and smart drivers. These solutions reduce writer node upgrade downtime during switchover by detecting the topology change and redirecting connections to the new production environment without waiting for DNS propagation.
